title: 685. Path Sum IV
hints: Decode each entry: hundreds are depth, tens are position, ones are the node value.
Store the values in a map keyed by (depth, position); children of (d, p) sit at (d+1, 2p-1) and (d+1, 2p).
Depth-first walk from (1, 1), adding the running total whenever a node has no children in the map.
